mechanism_narrative: A sustained low level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals accommodative monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to compressed yield curves.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS below 1.0% consistently produces positive 20-day returns in >60% of cases, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 5.0% indicates weak labor market conditions that suppress consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 5.0% consistently produces positive 20-day returns in >60% of cases, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous expansion in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals robust consumer demand that accelerates corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST > 1500 and RSAFS > 540000 consistently produce negative 5-day returns in >60% of cases, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% indicates active monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates and reduces risk appetite, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days during tightening cycles.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4.5% consistently produces positive 60-day returns in >60% of cases, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of total nonfarm employment (PAYEMS) signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate profitability, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS above 140,000 consistently produces negative 20-day returns in >60% of cases, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level below 1400.0 thousand units indicates weak residential construction that signals deteriorating consumer confidence and reduced economic activity, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST < 1400.0 consistently produces positive 20-day returns in >60% of cases, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and rise in consumer inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals stagflationary pressures that increase corporate input costs and reduce profit margins, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 100 and CPIAUCSL > 250 consistently produce positive 60-day returns in >60% of cases, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A GDP level above 17000 billion dollars indicates strong economic expansion that accelerates corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days during expansionary regimes.
failure_condition: GDPC1 > 17000 consistently produces negative 60-day returns in >60% of cases, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
